Delhi High Court Chauffeur Stage III Interview Admit Card 2026 - Complete Details

High Court of Delhi, New Delhi has released the Interview Admit Card (Call Letter) for Stage III Interview for the post of Chauffeur (Driver) Examination 2026. Qualified candidates can download their admit card online from the official Delhi High Court recruitment portal.

Important Dates

  • Stage I Exam : Conducted 2025
  • Stage II Skill Test : Conducted 2026
  • Stage III Interview Admit Card : 19 September 2026
  • Interview Date : September - October 2026
